text:
prod-monitor: alert: spike in 502s from edge-gateway -> hosted-api (us-east-1). 5xx rate 7% over 5m, top upstream: auth-proxy. sample trace: trace=0a1b2c3d
suki-support: saw the alert, adding SRE + oncall. any customer reports? @customer-acct can you confirm impact? :eyes:
customer-acct: yep customers complaining about failed generation calls and timeouts. We saw retries bubble up in our logs, lots of 502s between 20:10-20:18 UTC. Example trace id from client: client-trace-7788
jordan-sre: quick triage: envoys showing upstream reset + HTTP/2 GOAWAY on auth-proxy nodes. Upstream responses to envoy are 502/503/504. I’m pulling envoy upstream logs now.
maria-eng: attempting repro from internal: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
```
- got: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway, upstream reset
- envoy log snippet: `[2026-03-17T20:12:05Z] upstream reset: stream=1456 reason=ENVOY_STREAM_RESET` 
- auth-proxy logs show a burst of 429s and 503s when contacting auth validator cluster: `revalidate token id=abcd status=429` 
lyn-oncall: looks like auth validator cluster is being hammered with revalidation requests. Could be token rotation or cache miss storm. Any deploys to auth service recently? :thinking:
deploy-bot: deploy event: auth-service v4.3.1 deployed at 2026-03-17T19:55:12Z by ci/pipeline #987 (rollback available)
jordan-sre: correlation: deploy + token rotation job ran at 19:57 — token rotation might be invalidating caches and causing thundering revalidations. Also ingress started seeing large fanout when long-lived streaming calls reconnect.
suki-support: can we repro with a simple concurrent loop to simulate fanout? maria-eng, can you run 50 concurrent curl requests (no wait) against one token to see cache behavior?
maria-eng: running small repro: 50 concurrent -> 62% 502/504 across calls, auth-proxy shows spike in `revalidate` latency and a huge number of cache misses. Stack trace in auth-proxy: `cache.Get(key) -> miss -> call validator -> hit rate dropped from 98% to 12%`.
lyn-oncall: immediate mitigations I recommend: 
- enable auth-cache bypass=false (toggle edge.feature.auth_cache_warmup = true) to force warm cache? (short term)
- scale auth-validator replicas 3 -> 8
- rollback auth-service v4.3.1 if it has a regression
jordan-sre: I’m scaling auth-validator to 8 now (k8s HPA override) and bumping connection pool on edge->auth cluster. Patching envoy cluster timeout to be slightly higher for now.
maria-eng: executed concurrent repro after scaling: error rate fell to ~3% but not fully recovered. We rolled back auth-service to v4.3.0 (deploy-bot initiated rollback: #987 -> rollback -> success at 20:28)
deploy-bot: rollback complete: auth-service v4.3.0 restored by ci/pipeline #987-rollback
customer-acct: after rollback we still see intermittent 502s for high concurrency customers, but much improved.
jordan-sre: dug deeper: root cause = token rotation job caused many tokens to become marked as stale resulting in cache invalidation across edge nodes. New auth-service changed revalidation backoff behavior (no client-side debounce), so all edge nodes immediately revalidated causing a thundering herd. Envoy upstreams started resetting connections due to connection saturations on auth-proxy.
lyn-oncall: next actions:
- add client-side debounce/ jitter to auth revalidations in auth-service and edge SDK
- add short-lived local in-memory cache fallback in edge (TTL 60s) for revalidation results
- add circuit-breaker on edge->auth cluster to protect validator (max concurrent 200)
- schedule postmortem with product + security to review token rotation procedure
suki-support: customer communications: notify affected customers that we've mitigated, we rolled back release and scaled validators, root cause under investigation; estimated time to full recovery 2h for cache warm-up across all nodes.
maria-eng: logs now: envoy 5xx rate down to 0.6% over last 5m. auth-proxy 429s gone after scaling and rollback. adding smoke test to CI to simulate token rotation.
customer-acct: thanks team — will update customers. any ETA on permanent fix?
jordan-sre: ETA for small fixes (circuit-breaker + jitter) 2d, full solution including token-rotation playbook + rollout testing 1-2 weeks. Will follow up in incident doc.
prod-monitor: resolved alert at 20:45 UTC, 5xx rate back to baseline.
lyn-oncall: I'll open a postmortem ticket and include repro script + suggested config changes. ping me for any gaps. :white_check_mark:
